falsifiable_hypothesis: The raw cross-patient median bandwidth has the lowest point MSE but slight fold instability, while deterministic bias corrections trade mean error for stability. Bagging the kernel over the actual fitting-only delete-one-patient bandwidth distribution can reduce estimator variance while preserving the raw geometry center.
geometry_rule: Within every fitting slice compute the response-free raw per-drug bandwidth and all delete-one-whole-patient bandwidth vectors using the same weighted-median estimator. For each drug group, replace the single RBF with the equal-weight arithmetic mean of the RBF kernels induced by all delete-one-patient bandwidths. The linear kernel term is unchanged. Equal positive averaging preserves PSD. There is no bandwidth distribution fit, correction strength or tuning grid.
spectral_rule: Reuse the bandwidth-0.7 spectral option already selected within each outer-training partition by the authenticated public replay.

task_contract.ab_rule: average separately costed A/B losses; never average A/B predictions
